question: In 2021, Dr. Padmaja Suresh was awarded the title of 'Karnataka Kalashree' for her best performance in which dance form?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bharatanatyam**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Dr. **Padmaja Suresh** was honored with the prestigious title of **'Karnataka Kalashree'** in **2021** for her excellence and contribution to the classical dance form **Bharatanatyam**.
 
• **Bharatanatyam** is one of the oldest and most revered forms of Indian classical dance, originating in **Tamil Nadu**. It is deeply rooted in the **Natya Shastra**, an ancient Sanskrit treatise on performing arts.
 
• As a renowned dancer, Dr. Padmaja Suresh has dedicated her life to preserving and promoting **Indian classical dance**, especially Bharatanatyam, through performances, workshops, and academic engagements.
 
• The **'Karnataka Kalashree'** title is awarded to individuals who have significantly contributed to the field of arts, culture, and heritage in Karnataka.
 
• Dr. Padmaja Suresh's recognition highlights her immense talent, dedication, and contribution to the preservation and propagation of **Bharatanatyam** as an art form.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Bharatanatyam:**

 
 
• **Origin:** Bharatanatyam is believed to have originated more than 2,000 years ago in **South India**, particularly in temples of Tamil Nadu.
 
• **Philosophy:** It is deeply connected to **spiritual themes**, portraying stories from Hindu mythology and expressing devotion to deities such as **Lord Shiva, Vishnu, and Krishna**.
 
• **Technique:** This dance form incorporates complex footwork, graceful hand gestures (**mudras**), and intricate facial expressions (**abhinaya**) to convey emotions and narratives.
 
• **Structure:** A Bharatanatyam performance is divided into several segments, including **Alarippu, Jatiswaram, Varnam, Tillana**, and **Padams**. Each segment showcases different aspects of rhythm, expression, and storytelling.
 
• **Costume:** The dancers wear traditional attire consisting of colorful silk sarees, adorned with intricate jewelry and expressive makeup, including exaggerated eye designs.
 
 
 
• **Karnataka Kalashree Award:**
 
 
• This award is presented by the **Karnataka Government** to individuals excelling in various forms of art, culture, and heritage.
 
• It recognizes contributions to fields such as **classical music, dance, theater, literature**, and visual arts.
 
• The recipients of the award are celebrated for their efforts in promoting and preserving the cultural traditions of **Karnataka and India**.
 
 
 
• **Other Indian Classical Dance Forms:**
 
 
• **Mohiniattam:** Originating from **Kerala**, this dance form is known for its graceful movements and feminine charm, often revolving around themes of love and devotion.
 
• **Kathak:** A classical dance form from **North India**, characterized by intricate footwork, spins, and storytelling through gestures and facial expressions.
 
• **Sattriya:** Originating in **Assam**, it was introduced by the saint **Srimanta Sankardeva** and is traditionally performed in monasteries as a form of devotional expression.
 
 
 
• **Natya Shastra:**
 
 
• It is an ancient Sanskrit text attributed to the sage **Bharata**, considered the foundation of Indian classical dances.
 
• The text outlines the principles, postures, gestures, and techniques of performing arts, including dance, drama, and music.
 
• It serves as the basis for the classical dance forms of India, including **Bharatanatyam, Kathakali, and Odissi**.
